thread:
Ravi Malhotra: heads-up i'm opening a small PR to clarify our grace period behavior on quota exhaustion and patch a couple of broken links in the billing/tiering pages. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/724 (internal)

Claire Bennett: what's the exact change for grace periods? customers keep asking if they get an automatic 24h buffer.

Ravi Malhotra: not automatic. the change clarifies semantics: we offer a configurable grace period (default 72 hours for enterprise, 24h for self-serve tiers) that applies to soft-quota hits. docs previously implied a universal 24h buffer which is wrong. adding a table and sample config snippet.

Noah Feldman: can you paste the config snippet you added? i'll sync it to the infra playbook.

Ravi Malhotra: added this in PR:

```
# tenant config (example)
{
  "tenant_id": "acme",
  "quota": {
    "committed_units": 100000,
    "grace_period_hours": 72,
    "burst_enabled": true
  }
}
```

Ravi Malhotra: also added copy that explains how grace interacts with alerts and billing: grace allows requests to continue for the window, alerts fire at the configured thresholds, billing occurs as usual for overage units (unless overridden by a negotiated contract).

Claire Bennett: make sure the Quickstart SDK examples show a runtime check so customers can handle a soft-quota state. a small JS snippet would be helpful.

Ravi Malhotra: added this quick snippet to the client section:

```
// detect soft quota from response headers
const res = await fetch('/v1/requests', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${KEY}` } });
if (res.headers.get('X-RW-Quota-State') === 'soft') {
  console.warn('soft quota: consider backing off');
}
```

Noah Feldman: good. about the link fixes: which broken links were you hitting?

Ravi Malhotra: two internal anchors on the tier mapping table and one old metrics dashboard permalink. updated the permalink to the new Grafana UID and fixed anchor ids. left redirect notes for the old links in the PR description.

support-bot: triggered: notify-support-channel set to true. will post a short customer-ready blurb after merge.

Claire Bennett: docs-ci  can you send the preview once CI finishes? i'll do a quick pass for wording.

docs-ci: CI passed  preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/changes/724 (expires in 7 days) :white_check_mark:

Noah Feldman: quick nit: in the table, include the recommended alert thresholds for grace-enabled accounts (warning at 80%, critical at 98%). otherwise approved from infra side.

Ravi Malhotra: added thresholds and small FAQ entry about negotiated contracts. scheduled a follow-up automation to remove the old permalink fallbacks in 45 days.

Claire Bennett: LGTM after that tiny wording tweak on the FAQ. will approve in PR.

Ravi Malhotra: merging in 10m unless anyone objects. will ping #announcements and #support with the customer blurb and the preview link. thanks!
